name: 48979-batchdecode-dsv4flash-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, all eight GPUs of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=8, EP on, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process engine over the eight GPUs of one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), 17 streams, bounded at 544 requests / 1800 s safety, with 10% warmup and 10% cooldown by percent.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 512 tokens and output exactly 512, `request_format: plain`, `temperature: 0.0`, Faker-generated prompts distinct per request.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating 512-token replies for 17 concurrent users on one eight-GPU node.
launch:
# Engine: commit 08e50675615fc0b3e4e458645d8dd16cefb371bd
# (`git describe --tags --match 'v*'` = v0.23.1rc0-1360-g08e50675615f -- a commit, not a release).

# 46 safetensors shards, 159.62 GB, public and ungated. NOT ON THIS MACHINE -- see configs/env.yaml.
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash

tensor-parallel-size: 8

# 256 experts a layer split 32 to a rank rather than replicated. Nothing is sliced along
# `moe_intermediate_size` 2048, so the MXFP4 block scales stay whole.
enable-expert-parallel: true

# The in-tree NCCL collective pair -- no DeepEP, no NIXL -- so the expert exchange stays on NVLink
# inside the node and nothing touches the NIC.
all2all-backend: allgather_reducescatter

# FORCED, not preferred: `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV4.supports_compute_capability` is
# `major in [10, 12]` at this commit and refuses SM90; this sibling for the same model family is
# `major in [9, 10]`.
attention-backend: FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV4

# Halves the sparse-MLA KV pool against the bf16 default.
kv-cache-dtype: fp8

# HAZARD, see configs/note.md: without this every request errors instantly on an engine that
# looks healthy. One KV cache group, so the scheduler and the worker read the same cache layout.
disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager: true

tokenizer-mode: deepseek_v4

# The checkpoint declares `max_position_embeddings: 1048576`; the worst case here is 512 prompt
# tokens plus 512 generated. Not binding on any request.
max-model-len: 4096

error.text: the setup needs a model runner that has no supported path on H100 GPUs at these commits
